title: Spicy Sour Noodle Soup
description: A refreshing and spicy noodle soup that combines the tanginess of sour ingredients with the comfort of a warm bowl.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook the noodles according to package instructions.
In a separate pot, combine the sour cream, vinegar, carrots, celery, and ginger. Bring to a simmer.
Add the cooked noodles to the sour cream mixture and toss to coat.
Cook the Canadian bacon in a pan until crispy. Chop into small pieces.
Add the cooked Canadian bacon to the noodle mixture and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
